title: El Estado Plurinacional y la refundación constitucional
goal: Examine the 2009 constitutional refoundation of Bolivia as a Plurinational State, 36 indigenous nations, and Suma Qamaña.
grammar: derecho constitucional plurinacional, pluralismo jurídico comunitario, Wiphala y Vivir Bien

items: Analyze the constitutional recognition of thirty-six native indigenous nations.
Explore the legal equality between indigenous community justice and ordinary state justice.
Deploy constitutional law, decolonization, and indigenous statecraft vocabulary (wiphala, plurinacionalidad, originario, comunitario).
